{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_announce_policy_5112", "thread_id": "th_ann_pol_5112", "from_": "vp-people@company.example.com", "to": ["hr-ops@company.example.com"], "subject": "Promotion Announcement Guidelines", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-03-15T08:00:00Z"}

主题：Promotion Announcement Guidelines
Team,

Guidelines for promotion announcements:

1. Only vertical promotions (title level increase) are announced company-wide.
2. Lateral moves (same level, different team) are NOT included in promotion announcements. They are communicated separately by the receiving team's manager.
3. Announcements go to all-company@company.example.com.
4. Employees with a 'hold' or 'pending' note should not be announced until the note is cleared.

- VP People"}
